change: Checked renderer output/readback extents and corrected odd-image/fractional clipping coverage
architecture: Physical extent and readback validity remain private renderer responsibilities; domain contracts, adapters, design tokens and desktop sizing policy are unchanged
extent_validation: Zero dimensions/scale, scaled multiplication overflow and requested-device texture limits
Readback row multiplication/alignment overflow, padded device-buffer limits and host slice capacity
Seven rejected GPU snapshot requests followed by valid padded readbacks at 1x and 2x

clipping_reproduction.after: Exact opaque/transparent pixels match at five odd target sizes and both densities, including fractional clip boundaries; eight focused renderer tests pass on both drivers

runtime.notes: Native VM checks. Presentation recovery policy is unit-tested; driver fault injection is not covered here.

native.deployment_scope: Desktop executable only; existing lock/login executables were not replaced

limits: Output validation does not validate every scene texture, text raster or geometry allocation
Device limits do not guarantee available memory; allocation/device-loss injection remains unverified
Native oversized-output rejection was not injected; invalid requests were tested offscreen and through the shared pure validator
Late discard can execute shader work for clipped fragments; no performance improvement is claimed
Hardware checks are offscreen; native hardware frame pacing, fractional scaling and hotplug remain unverified
Existing secure lock/unlock passed; interactive root-greeter login was not rerun
